content.introduction: On November 6, 2026, Tokyo Electron Ltd PK ADR, Enbridge, and Moderna are scheduled to report earnings. Tokyo Electron Ltd PK ADR is expected to report earnings per share (EPS) of 1.32 with revenue forecasts of $5.49 billion against $117.48 billion in market capitalization, with a revenue revision range of 25.01-17.43%. Enbridge is expected to report EPS of 0.4991 with revenue forecasts of $13.37 billion against $107.04 billion in market capitalization, with a revenue revision range of 48.11-1.37%. Moderna is expected to report a loss of -1.09 with revenue forecasts of $892.41 million against $96.25 billion in market capitalization, with a revenue revision range of 241.46-6.55%.
